_comment: BASE structured-state domains. The GM writes VALIDATED deltas into mem['ledger'] (in world_memory, save-safe; NEVER canon gvars). A content mod adds domains by dropping registry/<mod>.state.json (an open registry, like *.checks.json). predicates: type=enum|string|number, values (for enum), in_prompt (inject into the model's context). mutex: groups of predicates of which a subject can hold only ONE (setting one clears the siblings). The starting domains are object_state (which formalizes the older ad-hoc mem['objects'] store) and faction_stance (the freedom unlock FO2 does not natively model).
